column1: # Rows db.o4b2_10.* (line NP item O4b2-10): a batch whose prefetch meets a Seq-align id whose lookup throws (a text tag): NCBI's prefetch loads the Seq-id handles below the failing one in its map and ends there (BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/offset_last_past_end; tests/db_search/ids/ptagc_t5, ptagx_t5 of make_ids.py --pfworder-only, pshare_t5 of --pfwarn-only); the loads before the failure go to NCBI's data source's cache of 10, not to the scope (pslot11_t5, pslot12_t5, pslot10_t5, pslotc_t5, pslotr_t5, pslotm_t5 of --pfworder-only, query pordslot_q.faa); a load of the failure's key, made or not (ptie_t5, ptie150_t5); two volumes (pvab_t5, pvcd_t5); NCBI wrote the same bytes of each ncbi row in four heap layouts. The losat-rejection rows: the default outfmt 6 (NCBI's null pointer exception reports its own addresses) and pshare_t5's tie (both handles unpacked, ordered by address).
